source_split_boundary_rules: Every PopSign row must record source_split_id from the source dataset.
Project split may mirror or narrow the source split, but source validation and source test rows must never enter project train.
Rows lacking trustworthy source_split_id must be quarantined until source identity is fixed.
signer_disjoint_proof: Every pseudonymous signer group must map to exactly one project split.
Rows with unknown or ambiguous signer grouping must use a conservative leakage_group_id and be quarantined unless a later receipt proves safety.
A future source manifest receipt must report signer group counts by source split, project split, and canonical label.
duplicate_clip_and_frame_grouping: Exact duplicate raw_clip_sha256 values must share duplicate_clip_group_id.
Near-duplicate clips identified by source metadata or future audits must share a leakage_group_id.
Frame_reference_ids that resolve to the same timestamp/frame index sequence must share duplicate_frame_group_id.
Duplicate groups must not cross project train/validation/test boundaries unless quarantined.
train_validation_test_separation: No leakage_group_id may appear in more than one non-quarantine project split.
No clip_id may appear in more than one non-quarantine project split.
No raw_clip_sha256 may appear in more than one non-quarantine project split.
label_coverage_accounting: A future materialized manifest must report row_count by canonical_label_id, source_split_id, project_split_id, source_id, and row_authority_state.
Labels with zero validation or zero test rows must be reported as coverage gaps, not silently promoted.
The source manifest contract does not create active recognition labels.
rejection_rules_for_ambiguous_or_missing: Reject or quarantine rows missing source_id, source_decision_id, license, attribution, raw_clip_reference, raw_clip_sha256, clip_id, source_split_id, or frame_reference_ids.
Reject rows from sources not allowed by the current source register.
Quarantine rows with uncertain signer identity, split boundary, duplicate grouping, or checksum mismatch.
Quarantine rows whose raw_clip_reference points to preview videos or other disallowed PopSign media.

raw_media_handling: A future manifest may reference raw clips by local/source reference and checksum.
This contract does not authorize downloading, copying, committing, or redistributing raw media.
Raw clip references must be enough for local reproducibility without exposing private signer identity.
privacy_fields: Use pseudonymous signer ids or group ids only.
Do not encode names, emails, device ids, or direct learner identifiers in row ids or clip ids.
First-party rows remain candidate-only until clip-level consent and signer registry evidence exist.
attribution_retention: Each PopSign row must carry source_license_name and source_attribution_text.
Any future packet receipt must summarize attribution coverage and missing-attribution quarantines.

offline_label_provenance_for_later_sidec.sidecar_wording_required_later: targets offline-derived via MediaPipe Holistic; runtime uses only our scratch-trained model and is not a runtime dependency.
offline_label_provenance_for_later_sidec.manifest_role: The source manifest must carry source authority and amendment ids so later label sidecars can bind to approved supervision scope.
offline_label_provenance_for_later_sidec.runtime_dependency_boundary: Offline labelers are not browser runtime dependencies and do not create ASL correctness authority.

validation_prerequisites_before_future_s: Current source register parses and its SHA-256 matches the manifest source_register_sha256.
Every non-quarantine row source_id is present in the current source register and allowed for the row's project role.
Every PopSign row includes source_decision_id approved_popsign_v1_original_videos_2026_05_20 and offline_derived_label_amendment_decision_id approved_popsign_v1_offline_derived_labels_2026_05_30.

Every non-quarantine row includes raw_clip_reference, raw_clip_sha256, clip_id, source_split_id, project_split_id, canonical_label_id, pseudonymous signer group, frame_count, frame_sampling_policy, and frame_reference_ids.
Source train/validation/test boundaries are preserved and no leakage_group_id, signer group, clip_id, or raw_clip_sha256 crosses non-quarantine project splits.
Duplicate clip/frame groups are reported and quarantined when they would cross split boundaries.
Attribution coverage is complete for every authoritative row.
Coverage accounting reports counts by source, split, label, signer group, row authority state, and frame sampling policy.
No label sidecars, extracted frames, packet rows, tensors, training, or evaluation consume source rows until this validation has passed.
Claim surfaces remain fail-closed before and after validation.

before_label_sidecars: This contract does not authorize label sidecar creation or labeler execution.
A separate label-sidecar contract must define method/version/config/run id, coordinate, confidence, visibility, manual-review, and provenance fields.
before_source_manifest_materialization: This contract defines schema only; it does not create source rows.
A future materialized manifest must pass the validation prerequisites in this contract.
before_packet_materialization_or_tensor_: No packet manifest, frame files, label files, tensor files, or model inputs are created or authorized here.
Packet materialization remains blocked until source manifest and label sidecar evidence exist.
before_training_evaluation_brev_export_o: No training or evaluation command is authorized.
No Brev lifecycle action is authorized; any future Brev work requires explicit human approval and a bounded compute receipt.
No export, promotion, browser activation, final-gate change, recognizer work, or claim expansion is authorized.
